prose: TechCrunch reports Town's $108M Series B at a $1B valuation, co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures. The two-year-old San Francisco startup, founded by former Plaid CTO Jean-Denis Greze, launched publicly just four months ago, says it reached millions in ARR within weeks, and has now raised at least $160M including June's $55M Series A. Town builds enterprise AI assistants and was also named this week among the work-focused agents transacting through Stripe Link - the agent-commerce rails and the agent vendors are raising in the same news cycle.
highlights: Town raises $108M Series B at a $1B valuation
Co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures
Founded by former Plaid CTO Jean-Denis Greze; launched publicly 4 months ago
Claims millions in ARR within weeks of launch; $160M+ raised to date
Builds enterprise AI assistants; also among Stripe Link's work-agent users
